name: smwblocks-target
title: Target
description:
This block will teleport you to another level (set in the .asm file) after you collected 8 (customizable) of it. They shatter when you touch them. Uses one byte of empty RAM - this address can be altered easily and has to be in the 16-bit range ($0000-$1FFF).

Knight of Time update: Works with SA-1 now.
